bug: Queue construction read the observer option up to three times, allowing accessor-backed configuration to validate one value and retain another. Invalid retained callbacks could fail notification after command execution.

cases: An initially absent observer was replaced by an unexpected callback.
An initially valid callback was replaced by a different callback.
A valid callback was validated but a non-function was retained, failing after execution.
A subsequent getter read threw despite a valid initial value.
An invalid initial value was accepted after a subsequent read returned a function.

fix: Read the observer option once, validate that captured value and retain it.

verification.typecheck: passed (production and test sources); explicit undefined runtime fixture uses a test-only cast for exactOptionalPropertyTypes

limits: Changing option accessors are exercised by controlled unit tests; browser checks cover ordinary editing integration.
The separate WebKit numeric fault remains unresolved; native instrumentation stayed paused.
